# Publishing policy

This is the only file that holds the outward-action mode. If it is missing, every outward action is blocked.

## Outward-action mode
- outward-action-mode: (draft-only or schedule)

`draft-only` means the team writes a manual posting package and does nothing outward. A mode that allows scheduling still needs your approval of each instance, and the team never posts straight to a live audience.
